parameters.name: ContainCustom
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return custom namespaces. Valid values:

*   **true**: The system returns custom namespaces.
*   **false**: The system does not return custom namespaces.

parameters.name: HybridCloudExclude
parameters.description:
Indicates whether hybrid cloud namespaces are excluded. Valid values:

*   **true**: Hybrid cloud namespaces are excluded.
*   **false**: Hybrid cloud namespaces are included.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae describe-namespace-list --contain-custom true --hybrid-cloud-exclude true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sae GET /pop/v1/sam/namespace/describeNamespaceList --region cn-hangzhou --ContainCustom true --HybridCloudExclude true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
